Create a 12-second Manim scene that explains gradient descent as repeated downhill steps on a loss surface. Use a contour-style basin on the left with a step-by-step path toward the minimum, and a compact loss-vs-iteration chart on the right that drops as the steps progress.

from manim import *

class GradientDescentContourStory(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text('Gradient Descent Moves Step by Step Toward Lower Loss', font_size=28).to_edge(UP)
        left_frame = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.14, width=5.2, height=4.8, color=GRAY_B).shift(LEFT * 3.2 + DOWN * 0.1)
        right_frame = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.14, width=4.0, height=4.8, color=GRAY_B).shift(RIGHT * 3.35 + DOWN * 0.1)
        basin_center = left_frame.get_center() + RIGHT * 0.25 + DOWN * 0.2
        contours = VGroup(*[
            Ellipse(width=w, height=h, color=BLUE_D, stroke_opacity=0.55).move_to(basin_center)
            for w, h in [(3.8, 2.8), (3.0, 2.15), (2.2, 1.55), (1.45, 0.95)]
        ])
        minimum = Dot(basin_center, color=YELLOW_D, radius=0.08)
        minimum_label = Text('minimum', font_size=18, color=YELLOW_D).next_to(minimum, DOWN, buff=0.14)
        path_points = [
            basin_center + np.array([-1.45, 1.05, 0]),
            basin_center + np.array([-0.95, 0.55, 0]),
            basin_center + np.array([-0.48, 0.18, 0]),
            basin_center + np.array([-0.18, 0.05, 0]),
        ]
        dots = VGroup(*[Dot(point, color=ORANGE, radius=0.07) for point in path_points])
        arrows = VGroup(*[
            Arrow(path_points[i], path_points[i + 1], buff=0.06, color=ORANGE, stroke_width=5)
            for i in range(len(path_points) - 1)
        ])
        axes = Axes(x_range=[0, 4, 1], y_range=[0, 2.6, 0.5], x_length=3.1, y_length=2.7, tips=False).move_to(right_frame.get_center() + DOWN * 0.12)
        loss_curve = VMobject(color=TEAL_D, stroke_width=4)
        loss_curve.set_points_smoothly([
            axes.c2p(0, 2.2),
            axes.c2p(1, 1.35),
            axes.c2p(2, 0.78),
            axes.c2p(3, 0.48),
        ])
        loss_dots = VGroup(*[Dot(axes.c2p(x, y), color=TEAL_D, radius=0.05) for x, y in [(0, 2.2), (1, 1.35), (2, 0.78), (3, 0.48)]])
        axis_labels = VGroup(Text('step', font_size=18, color=WHITE).next_to(axes.x_axis, DOWN, buff=0.12), Text('loss', font_size=18, color=WHITE).next_to(axes.y_axis, LEFT, buff=0.12))
        caption = Text('Each update follows the local slope, and the loss readout falls as the weights approach the basin floor.', font_size=22, color=WHITE).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_group = VGroup(BackgroundRectangle(caption, fill_opacity=0.88, buff=0.14), caption)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), FadeIn(left_frame), FadeIn(right_frame), Create(contours), FadeIn(minimum), FadeIn(minimum_label), run_time=2.2)
        self.play(FadeIn(dots[0]), run_time=0.6)
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[GrowArrow(arrow) for arrow in arrows], lag_ratio=0.2), LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(dot) for dot in dots[1:]], lag_ratio=0.2), run_time=2.4)
        self.play(Create(axes), FadeIn(axis_labels), Create(loss_curve), FadeIn(loss_dots), run_time=2.2)
        self.play(FadeIn(caption_group), Indicate(minimum, color=YELLOW_A), run_time=1.6)
        self.wait(1)

from manim import *

class CommunicationsModulationStory(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Amplitude Modulation Wraps a Fast Carrier in a Slow Envelope", font_size=34).to_edge(UP)
        message_axes = Axes(x_range=[0, 6.5, 1], y_range=[-1.4, 1.4, 0.5], x_length=5.6, y_length=2.0, tips=False).to_edge(LEFT).shift(UP * 1.1)
        carrier_axes = Axes(x_range=[0, 6.5, 1], y_range=[-1.4, 1.4, 0.5], x_length=5.6, y_length=2.0, tips=False).to_edge(LEFT).shift(DOWN * 1.4)
        mod_axes = Axes(x_range=[0, 6.5, 1], y_range=[-1.8, 1.8, 0.5], x_length=5.6, y_length=4.4, tips=False).to_edge(RIGHT).shift(DOWN * 0.2)
        message = message_axes.plot(lambda x: 0.8 * np.sin(1.2 * x), x_range=[0, 6.2], color=BLUE_D)
        carrier = carrier_axes.plot(lambda x: np.sin(8 * x), x_range=[0, 6.2], color=GRAY_B)
        modulated = mod_axes.plot(lambda x: (1.1 + 0.45 * np.sin(1.2 * x)) * np.sin(8 * x), x_range=[0, 6.2], color=ORANGE)
        upper_env = mod_axes.plot(lambda x: 1.1 + 0.45 * np.sin(1.2 * x), x_range=[0, 6.2], color=TEAL_D)
        lower_env = mod_axes.plot(lambda x: -1.1 - 0.45 * np.sin(1.2 * x), x_range=[0, 6.2], color=TEAL_D)
        message_label = Text("message", font_size=22, color=BLUE_D).next_to(message_axes, UP, buff=0.15)
        carrier_label = Text("carrier", font_size=22, color=GRAY_D).next_to(carrier_axes, UP, buff=0.15)
        mod_label = Text("modulated signal", font_size=22, color=ORANGE).next_to(mod_axes, UP, buff=0.15)
        caption_a = Text("The message signal changes slowly and carries the information.", font_size=23, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_b = Text("The carrier oscillates much faster, providing a wave to transmit.", font_size=23, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_c = Text("After modulation, the carrier amplitude follows the message envelope.", font_size=23, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(message_axes), Create(message), FadeIn(message_label), FadeIn(caption_a), run_time=4)
        self.play(Create(carrier_axes), Create(carrier), FadeIn(carrier_label), ReplacementTransform(caption_a, caption_b), run_time=4)
        self.play(Create(mod_axes), Create(modulated), FadeIn(mod_label), ReplacementTransform(caption_b, caption_c), run_time=5)
        self.play(Create(upper_env), Create(lower_env), run_time=4)
        self.wait(2)

Create a short Manim scene with a moving camera that zooms onto a dot and follows it as the dot moves along a sine graph.

from manim import *

class FollowingGraphCamera(MovingCameraScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.frame.save_state()

        # create the axes and the curve
        ax = Axes(x_range=[-1, 10], y_range=[-1, 10])
        graph = ax.plot(lambda x: np.sin(x), color=BLUE, x_range=[0, 3 * PI])

        # create dots based on the graph
        moving_dot = Dot(ax.i2gp(graph.t_min, graph), color=ORANGE)
        dot_1 = Dot(ax.i2gp(graph.t_min, graph))
        dot_2 = Dot(ax.i2gp(graph.t_max, graph))

        self.add(ax, graph, dot_1, dot_2, moving_dot)
        self.play(self.camera.frame.animate.scale(0.5).move_to(moving_dot))

        def update_curve(mob):
            mob.move_to(moving_dot.get_center())

        self.camera.frame.add_updater(update_curve)
        self.play(MoveAlongPath(moving_dot, graph, rate_func=linear))
        self.camera.frame.remove_updater(update_curve)

        self.play(Restore(self.camera.frame))

from manim import *

class SimilarTrianglesScale(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#F8F8F6"
        ink = "#252525"
        title = Text("Similar triangles preserve angles and side ratios", font_size=36, color=ink).to_edge(UP)
        small = Polygon([-4,-1.5,0], [-1.8,-1.5,0], [-4,0.2,0], color=BLUE_D, fill_opacity=0.12)
        large = Polygon([0.2,-1.5,0], [4.6,-1.5,0], [0.2,1.9,0], color=TEAL_D, fill_opacity=0.12)
        angle_small = Arc(radius=0.35, start_angle=0, angle=np.arctan2(1.7, 2.2), color=ORANGE).move_arc_center_to(small.get_vertices()[0])
        angle_large = Arc(radius=0.55, start_angle=0, angle=np.arctan2(3.4, 4.4), color=ORANGE).move_arc_center_to(large.get_vertices()[0])
        side_small = BraceBetweenPoints(small.get_vertices()[0] + DOWN * 0.2, small.get_vertices()[1] + DOWN * 0.2, color=BLUE_D)
        side_large = BraceBetweenPoints(large.get_vertices()[0] + DOWN * 0.2, large.get_vertices()[1] + DOWN * 0.2, color=TEAL_D)
        labels = VGroup(
            Text("2", font_size=23, color=BLUE_D).next_to(side_small, DOWN),
            Text("4", font_size=23, color=TEAL_D).next_to(side_large, DOWN),
        )
        ratio = Text("scale factor = 2", font_size=26, color=ORANGE).shift(DOWN * 2.7)
        boundary = Text("Same shape and angles; corresponding lengths change.", font_size=23, color=ink).to_edge(DOWN)

Create a 30-second Manim scene that introduces a 3D surface. Show the axes, draw the surface, highlight one ridge curve on top of it, and orbit the camera while a probe dot moves along that ridge.

from manim import *

class SurfaceOrbitWalkthrough(ThreeDScene):
    def construct(self):
        def height(u, v):
            return 0.35 * np.sin(u) * np.cos(v) + 0.08 * u

        title = Text("A Surface Has Height in Every Direction", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
        caption_a = Text("The surface maps every (x, y) location to a height", font_size=26, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_b = Text("A ridge curve shows one slice through that height field", font_size=26, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_c = Text("Camera motion makes the shape easier to read", font_size=26, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(title, caption_a, caption_b, caption_c)
        caption_b.set_opacity(0)
        caption_c.set_opacity(0)

        axes = ThreeDAxes(x_range=[-3, 3, 1], y_range=[-3, 3, 1], z_range=[-2, 2, 1], x_length=7, y_length=7, z_length=4.5)
        surface = Surface(
            lambda u, v: axes.c2p(u, v, height(u, v)),
            u_range=[-3, 3],
            v_range=[-3, 3],
            resolution=(18, 18),
            checkerboard_colors=[BLUE_D, TEAL_D],
            fill_opacity=0.65,
        )
        ridge = ParametricFunction(lambda t: axes.c2p(t, 0.6, height(t, 0.6)), t_range=[-3, 3], color=YELLOW_D)
        probe = Dot3D(axes.c2p(-3, 0.6, height(-3, 0.6)), color=RED_D, radius=0.07)
        ridge_label = Text("ridge slice", font_size=22, color=YELLOW_D).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(ridge_label)
        ridge_label.set_opacity(0)

        self.set_camera_orientation(phi=65 * DEGREES, theta=-55 * DEGREES)
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(axes), FadeIn(caption_a), run_time=4)
        self.play(Create(surface), run_time=5)
        self.play(Create(ridge), FadeIn(ridge_label), FadeOut(caption_a), FadeIn(caption_b), run_time=4)
        self.play(FadeIn(probe), run_time=2)
        self.begin_ambient_camera_rotation(rate=0.12)
        self.play(MoveAlongPath(probe, ridge), FadeOut(caption_b), FadeIn(caption_c), run_time=8, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(3)
        self.stop_ambient_camera_rotation()

from manim import *

class TrainingLossCurve(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Training Loss", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
        axes = Axes(x_range=[0, 8, 1], y_range=[0, 4.5, 1], x_length=7, y_length=4, tips=False).shift(DOWN * 0.2)
        axis_labels = axes.get_axis_labels(Text("epoch", font_size=22), Text("loss", font_size=22))
        points = [(0, 4.0), (1, 2.8), (2, 1.9), (3, 1.3), (4, 0.95), (5, 0.72), (6, 0.58), (7, 0.50)]
        graph = VMobject(color=BLUE_D, stroke_width=4)
        graph.set_points_smoothly([axes.c2p(x, y) for x, y in points])
        dots = VGroup(*[Dot(axes.c2p(x, y), color=YELLOW_D, radius=0.06) for x, y in points[1::2]])
        plateau = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(dots[-2], dots[-1]), color=GREEN_D, buff=0.16)
        caption = Text("Early updates help most. Later steps still matter, but less.", font_size=24, color=GRAY_C).to_edge(DOWN)
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(axes), FadeIn(axis_labels), run_time=2)
        self.play(Create(graph), run_time=3)
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(dot) for dot in dots], lag_ratio=0.25), run_time=2)
        self.play(Create(plateau), FadeIn(caption), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

Create a 12-second music-theory scene showing how three evenly spaced beats and four evenly spaced beats fit into one shared cycle. Use two aligned timelines, pulse each rhythm in sequence, and highlight that they realign at the cycle boundary rather than on every beat.

from manim import *

class PolyrhythmAlignment(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Three against four realigns at the shared cycle", font_size=37).to_edge(UP)
        start_x, end_x = -5.0, 5.0
        lane3 = Line([start_x, 1.0, 0], [end_x, 1.0, 0], color=BLUE_B)
        lane4 = Line([start_x, -0.7, 0], [end_x, -0.7, 0], color=ORANGE)
        label3 = Text("3 beats", font_size=25, color=BLUE_B).next_to(lane3, LEFT)
        label4 = Text("4 beats", font_size=25, color=ORANGE).next_to(lane4, LEFT)
        xs3 = np.linspace(start_x, end_x, 4)
        xs4 = np.linspace(start_x, end_x, 5)
        beats3 = VGroup(*[Dot([x, 1.0, 0], color=BLUE_B, radius=0.11) for x in xs3])
        beats4 = VGroup(*[Dot([x, -0.7, 0], color=ORANGE, radius=0.11) for x in xs4])
        start_line = DashedLine([start_x, 1.5, 0], [start_x, -1.2, 0], color=GREEN)
        end_line = DashedLine([end_x, 1.5, 0], [end_x, -1.2, 0], color=GREEN)
        caption = Text("Internal beats differ; both rhythms meet again at the boundary.", font_size=24).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(Write(title), Create(lane3), Create(lane4), FadeIn(label3, label4, beats3, beats4))
        self.play(Create(start_line), Flash(beats3[0], color=GREEN), Flash(beats4[0], color=GREEN))
        self.play(Succession(*[Flash(dot, color=BLUE_B, flash_radius=0.35) for dot in beats3[1:]], lag_ratio=1), run_time=3)
        self.play(Succession(*[Flash(dot, color=ORANGE, flash_radius=0.35) for dot in beats4[1:]], lag_ratio=1), run_time=3)
        self.play(Create(end_line), Indicate(VGroup(beats3[-1], beats4[-1]), color=GREEN), FadeIn(caption))
        self.wait(2)

Create a 25-second multi-beat psychology explainer for signal detection theory. Plot overlapping noise and signal-plus-noise distributions, introduce a decision criterion, then shift the criterion left and show that both hits and false alarms increase. Emphasize the sensitivity-versus-bias distinction.

from manim import *

class SignalDetectionStory(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("A decision criterion trades misses against false alarms", font_size=34).to_edge(UP)
        axes = Axes(x_range=[-4, 5, 1], y_range=[0, 1.1, 0.2], x_length=9, y_length=4.2, tips=False).shift(DOWN * 0.25)
        noise = axes.plot(lambda x: np.exp(-0.5 * (x + 0.7) ** 2), x_range=[-4, 3.5], color=BLUE_B)
        signal = axes.plot(lambda x: np.exp(-0.5 * (x - 1.2) ** 2), x_range=[-2.5, 5], color=ORANGE)
        labels = VGroup(
            Text("noise", font_size=22, color=BLUE_B).move_to(axes.c2p(-2.2, 0.78)),
            Text("signal + noise", font_size=22, color=ORANGE).move_to(axes.c2p(3.15, 0.72)),
        )
        criterion_high = DashedLine(axes.c2p(1.4, 0), axes.c2p(1.4, 1.05), color=YELLOW)
        criterion_low = DashedLine(axes.c2p(0.1, 0), axes.c2p(0.1, 1.05), color=YELLOW)
        criterion_label = Text("criterion", font_size=22, color=YELLOW).next_to(criterion_high, UP, buff=0.05)
        false_alarm_high = axes.get_area(noise, x_range=[1.4, 3.5], color=BLUE_B, opacity=0.35)
        hit_high = axes.get_area(signal, x_range=[1.4, 5], color=ORANGE, opacity=0.25)
        conservative = Text("Beat 1 · higher criterion: fewer false alarms, more misses", font_size=23).to_edge(DOWN)
        liberal = Text("Beat 2 · lower criterion: more hits and more false alarms", font_size=23).to_edge(DOWN)
        boundary = Text("Criterion changes response bias; curve separation reflects sensitivity.", font_size=23, color=TEAL_B).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(Write(title), Create(axes), Create(noise), Create(signal), FadeIn(labels), run_time=2.5)
        self.play(Create(criterion_high), FadeIn(criterion_label, conservative, false_alarm_high, hit_high))
        self.wait(4)
        new_label = criterion_label.copy().next_to(criterion_low, UP, buff=0.05)
        self.play(Transform(criterion_high, criterion_low), Transform(criterion_label, new_label), ReplacementTransform(conservative, liberal), run_time=2.5)
        false_alarm = axes.get_area(noise, x_range=[0.1, 3.5], color=BLUE_B, opacity=0.35)
        hit = axes.get_area(signal, x_range=[0.1, 5], color=ORANGE, opacity=0.25)
        self.play(Transform(false_alarm_high, false_alarm), Transform(hit_high, hit), run_time=2)
        self.play(Indicate(false_alarm, color=BLUE_B), Indicate(hit, color=ORANGE))
        self.wait(3)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(liberal, boundary))
        self.wait(3)

Create a 30-second Manim scene that explains a 2D flow using stream lines and one moving probe only. Avoid tables and multiple side charts; instead use a single compact card that updates left, center, and right flow behavior as the probe moves.

from manim import *

class StreamlineProbeCardStory(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("One Probe Is Enough to Read the Flow", font_size=34).to_edge(UP)
        plane = NumberPlane(x_range=[-4, 4, 1], y_range=[-3, 3, 1], background_line_style={"stroke_opacity": 0.26}).shift(DOWN * 0.2)
        stream_lines = StreamLines(lambda pos: np.array([0.95 - 0.16 * pos[1], 0.18 * np.sin(pos[0]), 0.0]), x_range=[-4, 4, 0.8], y_range=[-3, 3, 0.8], stroke_width=2.2, max_anchors_per_line=20)
        probe = Dot(plane.c2p(-3.0, 0.9), color=YELLOW, radius=0.09)
        path = VMobject(color=YELLOW_D)
        path.set_points_smoothly([plane.c2p(-3.0, 0.9), plane.c2p(-1.4, 0.5), plane.c2p(0.2, 0.0), plane.c2p(1.8, -0.5), plane.c2p(3.0, -0.9)])
        zone_left = Rectangle(width=2.3, height=5.0, stroke_color=BLUE_D, fill_color=BLUE_D, fill_opacity=0.05).move_to(plane.c2p(-2.7, 0))
        zone_center = Rectangle(width=2.3, height=5.0, stroke_color=TEAL_D, fill_color=TEAL_D, fill_opacity=0.05).move_to(plane.c2p(0.0, 0))
        zone_right = Rectangle(width=2.3, height=5.0, stroke_color=GREEN_D, fill_color=GREEN_D, fill_opacity=0.05).move_to(plane.c2p(2.7, 0))
        card_left_lines = VGroup(Text("left zone", font_size=22, color=BLUE_D), Text("gentle lift", font_size=26, color=WHITE)).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.12)
        card_center_lines = VGroup(Text("center zone", font_size=22, color=TEAL_D), Text("mostly horizontal", font_size=26, color=WHITE)).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.12)
        card_right_lines = VGroup(Text("right zone", font_size=22, color=GREEN_D), Text("stronger push out", font_size=26, color=WHITE)).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.12)
        card_left = VGroup(BackgroundRectangle(card_left_lines, fill_opacity=0.92, buff=0.18), card_left_lines).to_corner(UR).shift(DOWN * 0.75)
        card_center = VGroup(BackgroundRectangle(card_center_lines, fill_opacity=0.92, buff=0.18), card_center_lines).to_corner(UR).shift(DOWN * 0.75)
        card_right = VGroup(BackgroundRectangle(card_right_lines, fill_opacity=0.92, buff=0.18), card_right_lines).to_corner(UR).shift(DOWN * 0.75)
        card_center.set_opacity(0)
        card_right.set_opacity(0)
        caption = Text("The card changes only when the probe reaches a new region, so the scene stays readable.", font_size=22, color=WHITE).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_group = VGroup(BackgroundRectangle(caption, fill_opacity=0.9, buff=0.16), caption)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(plane), FadeIn(card_left), FadeIn(caption_group), run_time=4)
        self.add(stream_lines)
        stream_lines.start_animation(warm_up=False, flow_speed=1.2)
        self.play(Create(zone_left), FadeIn(probe), run_time=3)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(zone_left, zone_center), FadeOut(card_left), FadeIn(card_center), run_time=3)
        self.play(MoveAlongPath(probe, path), run_time=5, rate_func=linear)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(zone_center, zone_right), FadeOut(card_center), FadeIn(card_right), run_time=3)
        self.wait(3)
